fact: UNICEF's Tahoua office chief said UNICEF contributed to computerising 68% of communes nationwide, and the ministry cited introduction of digital technologies with computerisation of civil registration.

Le Sahel reports that the restructured WURI project will fund computerisation of all communes and declaration centres and a new digital platform for civil-status events, aiming at a national civil register (RNEC); only 66% of births are declared.

WURI-Niger states a digital platform for managing civil status events is in service in 100 communes, with extension planned to 166 more communes and 38 diplomatic missions, and 244,310 birth certificates digitised.

fact: ActuNiger reports the 'INCI' computerisation solution for civil registration is deployed in 103 communes, with 40 more being integrated, per UNICEF's representative, and WURI aims to computerise 87 more communes by end 2025.

Niger's director general of territorial administration said on 2026-09-03 that progressive computerisation of communes and declaration centres and a sovereign platform for a National Civil Status Register are among the reform workstreams, with a first registration phase soon in Niamey.

The Diffa regional civil-status directorate (DRECM-R) reports that four communes in the region have been computerised and staff trained in digital tools, as part of modernising the civil-status system.

Biometric Update, citing Le Sahel, reports a WURI Niger pilot in Filingue that will digitise existing birth records at local council and judicial level while issuing birth certificates to 21,202 unregistered under-fives.
The INS Niger 2023 civil-status report says computerisation of civil-status acts began in 2023, with over 130 communes equipped for digitisation.
